claims.claim: 邪骨恶灵（Bonemass）召唤需要十根枯骨（Withered bone x10）
claims.evidence: infobox: summon = [[Withered bone]] x10；'He is summoned by placing 10 Withered bones'

claims.claim: 邪骨恶灵对钝击（Blunt）较弱，对劈砍（Slash）抗性、对火与穿刺（Fire/Pierce）高度抗性
claims.evidence: infobox: weak=Blunt, Frost; resistant=Slash; veryresistant=Fire, Pierce

claims.claim: 邪骨恶灵攻击包含近身挥击、毒云范围攻击、投掷后召唤小怪（骷髅/软泥怪）
claims.evidence: abilities: Punch(近战)；Area of Effect(9米范围毒云，130 Poison)；Throw(投掷后按几率生成 Skeleton/Blob)

claims.claim: 击败邪骨恶灵后获得愿望骨（Wishbone），用于寻找雪山地下银矿
claims.evidence: 'Defeating Bonemass provides the player with a Wishbone, which allows the player to easily locate Silver veins beneath the surface of Mountain biomes'

claims.claim: 邪骨恶灵的祭坛位于沼泽（Swamp），沉没墓穴内的符石可指引位置
claims.evidence: 'Bonemass' Forsaken Altar is located in Swamps. His location can be found when visiting Sunken Crypts...'
